paragraphs: Robert Gordon University (RGU) is a public university in Aberdeen, Scotland, founded as Robert Gordon's College in 1750. RGU is best known for energy (oil & gas) engineering, healthcare, pharmacy, business, and architecture — Aberdeen is the UK's energy industry capital. Often top-1 in the UK for graduate employability (Times Higher Education).

International students enter via International College at Robert Gordon University (ICRGU) — Navitas's pathway college on the RGU Garthdee campus. Foundation and Pre-Master programs lead into an RGU Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: Robert Gordon University (RGU) — государственный университет в Абердине, Шотландия. Основан как Robert Gordon's College в 1750. Известен энергетической инженерией (oil & gas), healthcare, фармацией, бизнесом и архитектурой — Абердин столица energy-индустрии UK. Часто №1 в UK по трудоустройству выпускников (Times Higher Education).

Международные студенты заходят через International College at Robert Gordon University (ICRGU) — pathway-колледж Navitas на кампусе RGU Garthdee. Foundation и Pre-Master программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру RGU.
